description: The bar chart compares the distribution of three components—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two categories, "Ours" and "Standard," as presented in the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision." The horizontal axis represents the two categories, "Ours" and "Standard," while the vertical axis shows the percentage contribution of each component. Each bar is segmented into three colored parts: blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other, with corresponding percentages labeled within each segment. For the "Ours" category, the Context component accounts for 60.6%, the Generated Response for 31.7%, and the Other for 7.7%. In contrast, the "Standard" category shows a Context contribution of 23.6%, a Generated Response of 51.1%, and an Other component of 25.3%. The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each component. The chart visually demonstrates that the "Ours" method relies more heavily on context, while the "Standard" method generates a larger proportion of responses and includes more other components.
